# S.K. Enterprise

> ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of cast iron (C.I.), stainless steel (S.S.) and gun metal (G.M.) sluice gates, penstocks, industrial valves, cocks, fittings and fasteners, based in Howrah, West Bengal, India.

- [Sluice gates, valves, cocks and fittings](https://www.skenterprisesluicegate.com/products): product catalog with specifications
- [Industrial fasteners (nuts and bolts)](https://www.skenterprisesluicegate.com/parts): fastener catalog
